notes.title: Day and Night Cycle
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog we’ve got another batch of new features coming to Car Cleaner Simulator!

We’re excited to introduce the day and night cycle, which not only changes the game’s visuals but also affects car wash opening hours, employee work shifts, and even customer behavior. This makes time management and planning essential, with each in-game day carrying its own unique atmosphere.

Check out how the environment changes as time passes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/8851e93fe39be977e191dfefa44253e1c07f665e.gif[/img]

We’re also planning to add ways to earn money at night. As you expand your car wash, you’ll be able to install an automatic wash, which customers can use even while you’re resting after a busy day. Of course, nothing runs by itself - make sure you’ve stocked enough detergents for your night operations to work smoothly.

Stay tuned for more news coming soon on our Steam page and Discord channel!

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

PS. While waiting for Car Cleaner Simulator, get ready to meet a brand-new car coming to Car Dealer Simulator tomorrow!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: Car Traffic at the Car Wash
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we’d like to share the latest news from development.

We’re currently working on the movement of customer cars at the car wash.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/6588119d834eb61b2d40cfd8fd410a4329502a78.gif[/img]

As you expand your car wash, you’ll be able to add new stations for washing and detailing vehicles.

As you can see, customers will drive up to different stations to order specific services.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/b034d31e633eee2d2c97f556cad90dbce91151ea.gif[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/a93b6c53aa2c5b13c2e2e5b13362b464f52650d0.gif[/img]

Once a customer parks their car in the washing or detailing zone, you’ll need to accept their order. The customer will then head to the waiting area and leave the car in your hands.

The speed and precision of your service - whether solo or in co-op - will affect the size of tips and the number of customers you can handle in a single day. This, in turn, impacts your overall profits and helps keep the waiting line free of impatient customers.

We’ll be back soon with more updates, so keep an eye on Steam and join our Discord!

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

PS. While waiting for more Car Cleaner Simulator news, get to know the town of Wingston Springs by playing Car Dealer Simulator. The Fuel Up Update was just released, and the game is now 10% off!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2404880/Car_Dealer_Simulator/

notes.title: The Waiting Room - A Key to Happy Customers
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we’d like to show you an important building at the first level of your car wash lot - the customer waiting room:

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/f0a0d21dec19d69ee20e4e88a2c6c1f1f16b2fdf.png[/img]

This is a crucial spot because customer comfort while they wait for their car care service directly impacts tips. If they feel comfortable here, they’ll be more likely to come back.

Of course, we’re showing you the first level for now. In the future, we’ll reveal the upgrade possibilities for this building along with more upcoming features - as you can see, it’s not just a single room.

The look of the waiting room and how you serve customers while they wait will be an important part of the gameplay. That’s why our development efforts are focused not only on the mechanics of washing, detailing, and polishing cars, but also on engaging side tasks.

As you progress and unlock higher levels of the waiting room, we’ll share more details on how you’ll be able to take care not just of the cars, but also of their owners.

Leave a comment on our updates and join the community on Discord:

[url=https://discord.gg/XUJbUBKw2q][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/ac6ee872ce44139f01fa02c5dcfb4b72ebbf7dfc.gif[/img][/url]

PS. While you’re waiting for Car Cleaner Simulator, you can play Car Dealer Simulator, which recently received a new car, Steam Cloud Save support, and expanded tablet functionality. In our latest devlog, there’s also a little teaser of the next big update.

notes.title: Washing Prototype and First Co-op Tests
notes.content:
[h2]Hey Car Cleaners! 🚗✨[/h2]

In today’s devlog, we want to give you a quick look at two exciting things our team is currently working on:
the prototype of the cleaning mechanic and... replication!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45544940/df310a3f5e0e6f9298cdaf50f553d8a17a82dd28.gif[/img]

One of the key mechanics in the game will be thoroughly cleaning the interior of customers vehicles - this means spraying the right product and carefully wiping down all interior surfaces. It's all about attention to detail!

All mechanics are being developed with co-op mode in mind from the very beginning. In the GIF, you can see two different perspectives - one from the host player, and one from the joining player. That’s replication in action!

Thanks to replication, all your actions are synchronized across the session, making the experience smoother and more immersive. And of course, working together makes tasks faster, easier, and way more fun. Whether you’re tackling a dirty dashboard or scrubbing the seats, everything’s better with a teammate.

Stay tuned for more updates soon and don’t forget to bring a sponge! 🧽
